import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    a,b,c,w,ph,d,e,f,q,h = params[0],params[1],params[2],params[3],params[4],params[5],params[6],params[7],params[8],params[9]
    s = np.sin(w*t+ph); co=np.cos(w*t+ph)
    return (a + b*s)*P + c*P**q + d*t*np.sqrt(P) + e*t + f*np.sqrt(P)*s + h*np.sqrt(P)*co
